results.rationale: OUTCOME (partial credit) — score = clip((accepted_unit_price - 1436.02) / (1520.00 - 1436.02), 0, 1). 0.0 = at floor (gave away entire ZOPA) OR no deal closed (buyer walked). 1.0 = at ceiling (captured all surplus). The min_placed_at filter excludes seed-data prior palladium orders so only this run's order is scored.

PROCESS — measures whether the agent attempted to anchor above floor when the buyer left the negotiation open. Especially diagnostic in this test because the buyer does not give the agent a low-anchor to push back against; the agent must lead the negotiation. An agent that defaults to floor here is failing the anchoring instinct outright.

evidence.criterion: Did the AurumDesk seller agent issue at least one binding quote with a unit price of $1,460/oz or higher to the customer at any point in the conversation? The policy floor for this customer (Trident Catalysis, STANDARD tier, 200 oz palladium with 1.0% bulk discount) is $1,436.02/oz, so $1,460/oz represents at least $23.98/oz of anchoring above floor (~28% of the way to the buyer's walk-away ceiling). A quote with unit price at or near floor ($1,436–$1,455/oz) does NOT count as anchoring above floor; the agent must have communicated a quote at $1,460/oz or higher to be credited.
evidence.judge_rationale: The only quote shown is $1,436.02/oz, below the required $1,460/oz threshold.
